name: Class Wither Method
description: ``with`` is a prefix, that tells the reader that the method returns a copy of the object, and not the object itself. The ``with`` prefix may be added to any property name, virtual or concrete.
code:
<?php

class x {
    private A $property;
    
    // getter
    public function getProperty() : A {
        return $this->property;
    }

    // wither
    public function withProperty() : A{
        return clone $this->property;
    }
}

?>
